name: Hangman
summary: Two-player word-guessing game where one player holds a secret word and the other guesses letters before the drawing is completed.
rules_text: One player (the host) chooses a secret word that must be in a standard dictionary, no proper nouns, abbreviations, slang, foreign words, contractions or hyphenations. Spelling must be correct. The other player is the guesser. On the guesser's turn, they call out a single letter. If the letter is in the secret word, the host reveals all occurrences of that letter. If not, the host advances a hangman dial by one step. After a correct letter guess, the guesser may also attempt to guess the whole word. If the whole-word guess is correct, the guesser wins immediately; if incorrect, the dial advances one step as a penalty. Players alternate roles or turns per house rules until either the full word is revealed or guessed, in which case the guesser wins, or the hangman drawing is completed, in which case the guesser loses.
rating_reason: Two-player hidden word, guessing letters, text-only strategic deduction
